description: Deploy only Vellum production after its signed release-specific recovery approval

ApprovalMode.description: Automated release-bound recovery evidence is required

runCommand: test -n "${SSM_Manifest:-}" || { echo 'SSM Agent ENV_VAR support required' >&2; exit 1; }
test "${SSM_ApprovalMode:-}" = automated || { echo 'SSM Agent ApprovalMode ENV_VAR support required' >&2; exit 1; }
test -n "${SSM_COMMAND_ID:-}" || { echo 'SSM Agent command identity required' >&2; exit 1; }
